# UAE Corporate Tax Client Engine

> A bilingual client intake and qualification platform for UAE accounting and tax firms. It helps firms convert Corporate Tax enquiries into structured consultation opportunities.

The platform is not affiliated with the UAE Federal Tax Authority and does not provide final tax or legal advice.

## Product

- [Home](https://uae-tax-client-engine.netlify.app/): Product overview and qualification example.
- [How It Works](https://uae-tax-client-engine.netlify.app/how-it-works): The journey from an enquiry to a consultation-ready lead brief.
- [Corporate Tax Assessment](https://uae-tax-client-engine.netlify.app/assessment): A guided readiness and qualification assessment.
- [Pricing](https://uae-tax-client-engine.netlify.app/pricing): Confirmed setup and monthly plans for accounting firms.

## Information

- [Privacy](https://uae-tax-client-engine.netlify.app/privacy): How prospect information is handled.
- [Terms and Disclaimer](https://uae-tax-client-engine.netlify.app/terms): Use limitations and professional-review requirements.

Private admin pages and APIs are intentionally excluded.
